text:
Anna (AE): kickoff for the POC with Lantern — they want to migrate from CompetitorX. objective: behavior reconciliation + pricing + security Qs. can we map acceptance criteria this week? @Marta can you lead evals?
Marta (Solutions Eng): yes. plan: build a small test harness, golden prompt set, and a set of edge-case probes (prompt truncation, multi-turn stateful, structured output). deliverable: pass/fail report + diffs.
Devin (SRE): I can stand up staging nodes. need expected qps and whether we should mimic their proxy headers for parity. also will provide egress IPs for their allowlist.
Marta (Solutions Eng): for parity metrics propose:
- intent_fuzzy >= 0.90 on golden set
- hallucination_rate <= 2% on hallucination suite
- structured_field_match >= 0.95
- cost_per_1k_tokens <= 0.8x competitor baseline (for quantized model)
- p50 latency < 300ms in their region
We'll capture token counts and use same system prompt.
Simon (Product): note — CompetitorX uses a slightly different tokenizer and prepends a hidden system token. that explains a lot of minor deltas. suggest we add a small prompt-normalizer shim that: strips their hidden token, canonicalizes whitespace, and pins system messages.
Marta (Solutions Eng): example shim config (pseudo):
```
normalize: true
strip_prefix_tokens: ["<SYS>"]
system_prompt: "You are an assistant that responds concisely."
truncate_policy: end
```
Jess (Security): quick security checklist items from their questionnaire: data residency, retention, KMS integration, SOC2 report, SSO + SCIM, and egress IPs. We can provide canned answers but need legal + infosec signoff for retention policy exceptions.
Ethan (Sales): pricing Qs from Lantern: are we doing POC credits or a short term commit? they asked for a 3-week POC estimate.
Marta (Solutions Eng): POC compute estimate: 50 concurrent users, avg 150 tokens/request, 5k requests/day -> ~750k tokens/day. estimate cost for POC (dev node + staging capacity) ~ $X (I'll add numbers after infra sizing).
Devin (SRE): staging is up. infra-bot deployed the env and returned staging creds. egress IPs for allowlist: 52.23.11.7, 52.23.11.8. logs here: https://redwood-infra/staging/lantern/logs
infra-bot: staging deployment complete for project lantern-poc. endpoint: https://staging.redwood.dev/lantern. creds in 1Password at /teams/sales/lantern-poc.
Anna (AE): great, next steps: Marta to deliver golden prompts + evaluation harness by Tue. Devin to confirm perf run window and provide ipsec for their network. Jess to draft security answers for items 3/7/9 and flag any blockers. Ethan to send POC quote + proposed credit amount.
Simon (Product): one more — acceptance criteria should include a subjective quality gate: cross-team blind eval with 20 annotated samples; if engineers can tell competitor vs RW more than 60% of time, we fail parity. helps catch subtle voice/style differences.
Marta (Solutions Eng): adding that. will generate the blind bucket and run a small Mechanical Turk style blind eval internally.
Ethan (Sales): will propose 2k USD credit and a refundable ramp fee so we can do proper load tests. :thumbsup:
Jess (Security): quick flag — Lantern's legal wants deletion certification in 72h for PII. our standard is 30d with delete-on-request. legal needs to approve exception.
Anna (AE): noted. I'll loop in Legal.
Marta (Solutions Eng): sample curl calls to compare responses (use these in harness):
```bash
# CompetitorX
curl -s -X POST https://api.competitorx/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $CXTOKEN" -d '{"prompt": "Summarize the benefits of Redwood Inference"}'
# Redwood (staging)
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.dev/lantern/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWSTAGE" -d '{"prompt": "Summarize the benefits of Redwood Inference"}'
```
Marta (Solutions Eng): I will attach the initial diff report to this thread when ready. expect an initial triage tomorrow afternoon.
Anna (AE): thanks team. scheduling 30m sync for Tue 10am PT to review metrics and decide go/no-go for pilot. agenda: acceptance results, security gaps, POC pricing.
Devin (SRE): noted, will run perf window Mon 11pm PT to emulate their traffic pattern.
infra-bot: perf run scheduled: 2024-04-08T23:00:00Z. results will post to the logs link above.
Ethan (Sales): ping me if Legal needs any quick contract tweaks.
Jess (Security): I'll post the drafted answers by EOD and flag any non-trivial exceptions.
Anna (AE): perfect — thread archived for prep. we'll reconvene after the perf run. :rocket:
